doc.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: The Benny Carter trumpet section and the Army film
summary: Carter was unhappy with his trumpet section, so Gerald brought Traynor, Walter Williams, himself and Snooky, heard also in This Is the Army.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: See the trumpet players that he had, I’m going to tell you, I remember it was Miles Davis.
Miles was one of the ones he wanted to let out. The fellow that married Sarah Vaughan? What was his name?
Yeah, Sarah’s first husband. He was the manager.
Treadwell. George Treadwell, Miles Davis, and I can’t think of the other two, but the whole trumpet section he was unhappy with it. Benny was unhappy with his trumpet section.
And that’s when Gerald said, it was Fred Traynor, Williams.

Walter Williams, Gerald Wilson and myself. That was the trumpet section we took into Benny Carter’s band. And also if you’d like to hear that trumpet section on film, you can hear us in “This is the Army” with a 60-piece Warner Brothers orchestra, with four trumpets and we are those four trumpets. Yes.
